text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a machine to identify what is in a picture. Another key task is object detection, where the computer finds and locates specific things within an image. These technologies have many useful applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs, and detect people and other vehicles. This helps them drive safely. Computer vision is also used in security cameras and medical imaging. As technology improves, computers will become even better at understanding the world around them.
